'''Choaaty Mossk''' was an agent of the [[G'uotr Network]] in the city of [[D'larah]] on the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a burly, bearded man with a long criminal record and a tendency to disobey the orders of his superiors in the Network. He was a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and repairman at D'larah's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and he used that knowledge to steal ships for the Network.
